title: Knight of the Willblade
summary: Seeking the Willblade, the Huntik team finally reaches the mythical island of Avalon with some help from Nimue. However, the team is ambushed by the Organization and a new Titan in Wilder's possession, Divine Mirror Kagami which was found by Hoffman, who can turn a Titan's power against it. Lok and Sophie find the Willblade. Ambushed by Wilder, Lok must unlock the true power of the Willblade with help from the ancient Seeker, Lord Casterwill, to save Sophie.

sections.heading: Plot
sections.wikitext:
'''The Organization Attack'''

In a cave in the Chu-Goku Mount in Japan, [[Hoffman]] and [[Eathon the dog]] unearth the [[Amulet]] of [[Divine Mirror Kagami]]. Hoffman vows to make the Huntik team pay for [[Simon Judeau|the Professor's]] demise.

On the English coast, [[Lok]] and [[Cherit]] look out to sea as they study another of [[Nostradamus]]' quatrains, hoping for clues on the location of [[Avalon]]. However a group of [[Suits]] attack the team's tents from the cliffs. [[Sophie]] invokes [[Sabriel]] to protect them while the Suits summon [[Venomaster]] and [[Bonelasher]]. The Huntik team disperse and Lok runs into the woods, closely followed by [[Gigadrone]]. Lok invokes [[Kipperin]] and, with help from [[Cherit]], defeats their pursuer. [[Dante]] crushes Bonelasher under a falling tree while Sophie and Sabriel defeat Venomaster. The team regroup at the [[Crystal Caves]] where the Suits refuse to follow them in, for fear of the [[Casterwill family]] magic protecting the place. Hoffman scoffs that, in his day, cowards would never be allowed in the [[Organization]], but, regardless, he backs off.

'''The Dragon's Breath'''

[[Nimue Casterwill]] believes the sword mentioned in the quatrain is the [[Willblade]], forged by the [[Elder daughter of Casterwill]], and takes the Huntik team to an ancient site called the [[Dragon's Cliffs]]. Cherit lights up the lamps in the cliff face, revealing a bridge of blue light stretching out across the sea - the Dragon's Breath. Two Suits arrive and threaten to open fire on Nimue unless they are given access to the bridge, to which Dante agrees. The smug agents jump off the cliff, but fall straight through the light and into the water. Nimue points out the bridge is not physical and is only meant to serve as a guide. The team bid farewell to Nimue and [[Vivian Casterwill|Vivian]] before setting off in the speedboat to follow the mist trail. Nimue summons [[Undine]] to accompany them for protection.

'''Avalon'''

As team arrive at the shore of Avalon, their boat is entangled in protruding roots cast by none other than [[Dark Dryad]]. Undine rescues the team and they escape as the boat explodes. Aware that the Organization is on their way, Sophie senses the castle and leads the team there. Keen to get the upper hand, [[Wilder]] invokes [[Divine Mirror Kagami]] while [[Stack]] uses [[Hidesight]] to render her invisible. At the ruins, Lok and Sophie go to find the Willblade while Dante, [[Zhalia]] and [[LeBlanche]] hold off the Organization. Zhalia invokes [[King Basilisk]] but things take a disastrous turn when Kagami appears reflect his Stonegaze ability. Dante jumps in front of Zhalia, and he and [[Caliban]] are turned to stone along with King Basilisk.

Inside the castle, Lok and Sophie find the Willblade only for Sophie to be knocked out by Wilder and [[Incubane]]. Invoking [[Dendras]], Lok takes control of Incubane. However, Wilder invokes Kagami, reflecting Dendras' ability and taking control of him. Overpowering Lok, Wilder blasts him backwards, landing and hitting his head on the stone in which the Willblade sits.

'''The Sword and the Comet'''

While [[Albion]] defeats [[Redcap]], LeBlanche uses [[Newlife]] to allow Zhalia to invoke King Basilisk again, saving Dante and turning him and Caliban back. Hoffman, Stack and the Suit quickly retreat.

As Wilder approaches the Willblade, Sophie grabs his leg determined to stop him. As Wilder prepares to use [[Venomhand]] to deal with her permanently, an injured Lok reaches for anything to help him save her. Grabbing the sword, there is a burst of blue light. All of a sudden, [[Lord Casterwill]] appears, knighting Lok and empowering him. As Incubane, Kagami and Dendras attack, Lok summons the Legendary Titan of Champions, [[Pendragon]], who breaks Wilder's control over Dendras, and defeats his [[Titans]]. Wilder is knocked out after being struck by the handle of the Willblade and Pendragon returns to the sword. As the castle collapses, Lok and Dante rescue Sophie. The team watches in shock as a [[Red Comet]] appears in the sky. Something has been set in motion and it's going to change the life of every [[Seeker]] on Earth.

Back at [[Dante Vale's house]], Lok and Cherit are unable to recall what happened on Avalon. As everyone leaves, Cherit ponders in mystery, sure that he saw his old friend, [[Lord Casterwill]], whose spectral form glows in the room.

full_text:
Lok and the Huntik team are on the trail of Avalon. Sophie is drawn to a crystal cave, where she must prove herself to the Casterwill Elder, Nimue. Sophie learns she is a direct descendant of Lord Casterwill and bonds with the Titan she thought was lost, empowering her and turning her into Powerbonded Sabriel. Nimue promises to help her find Avalon and the Willblade.

Synopsis

plot_sections.heading: Plot
plot_sections.wikitext:
'''The Organization Attack'''

In a cave in the Chu-Goku Mount in Japan, [[Hoffman]] and [[Eathon the dog]] unearth the [[Amulet]] of [[Divine Mirror Kagami]]. Hoffman vows to make the Huntik team pay for [[Simon Judeau|the Professor's]] demise.

On the English coast, [[Lok]] and [[Cherit]] look out to sea as they study another of [[Nostradamus]]' quatrains, hoping for clues on the location of [[Avalon]]. However a group of [[Suits]] attack the team's tents from the cliffs. [[Sophie]] invokes [[Sabriel]] to protect them while the Suits summon [[Venomaster]] and [[Bonelasher]]. The Huntik team disperse and Lok runs into the woods, closely followed by [[Gigadrone]]. Lok invokes [[Kipperin]] and, with help from [[Cherit]], defeats their pursuer. [[Dante]] crushes Bonelasher under a falling tree while Sophie and Sabriel defeat Venomaster. The team regroup at the [[Crystal Caves]] where the Suits refuse to follow them in, for fear of the [[Casterwill family]] magic protecting the place. Hoffman scoffs that, in his day, cowards would never be allowed in the [[Organization]], but, regardless, he backs off.

'''The Dragon's Breath'''

[[Nimue Casterwill]] believes the sword mentioned in the quatrain is the [[Willblade]], forged by the [[Elder daughter of Casterwill]], and takes the Huntik team to an ancient site called the [[Dragon's Cliffs]]. Cherit lights up the lamps in the cliff face, revealing a bridge of blue light stretching out across the sea - the Dragon's Breath. Two Suits arrive and threaten to open fire on Nimue unless they are given access to the bridge, to which Dante agrees. The smug agents jump off the cliff, but fall straight through the light and into the water. Nimue points out the bridge is not physical and is only meant to serve as a guide. The team bid farewell to Nimue and [[Vivian Casterwill|Vivian]] before setting off in the speedboat to follow the mist trail. Nimue summons [[Undine]] to accompany them for protection.

'''Avalon'''

As team arrive at the shore of Avalon, their boat is entangled in protruding roots cast by none other than [[Dark Dryad]]. Undine rescues the team and they escape as the boat explodes. Aware that the Organization is on their way, Sophie senses the castle and leads the team there. Keen to get the upper hand, [[Wilder]] invokes [[Divine Mirror Kagami]] while [[Stack]] uses [[Hidesight]] to render her invisible. At the ruins, Lok and Sophie go to find the Willblade while Dante, [[Zhalia]] and [[LeBlanche]] hold off the Organization. Zhalia invokes [[King Basilisk]] but things take a disastrous turn when Kagami appears reflect his Stonegaze ability. Dante jumps in front of Zhalia, and he and [[Caliban]] are turned to stone along with King Basilisk.

Inside the castle, Lok and Sophie find the Willblade only for Sophie to be knocked out by Wilder and [[Incubane]]. Invoking [[Dendras]], Lok takes control of Incubane. However, Wilder invokes Kagami, reflecting Dendras' ability and taking control of him. Overpowering Lok, Wilder blasts him backwards, landing and hitting his head on the stone in which the Willblade sits.

'''The Sword and the Comet'''

While [[Albion]] defeats [[Redcap]], LeBlanche uses [[Newlife]] to allow Zhalia to invoke King Basilisk again, saving Dante and turning him and Caliban back. Hoffman, Stack and the Suit quickly retreat.

As Wilder approaches the Willblade, Sophie grabs his leg determined to stop him. As Wilder prepares to use [[Venomhand]] to deal with her permanently, an injured Lok reaches for anything to help him save her. Grabbing the sword, there is a burst of blue light. All of a sudden, [[Lord Casterwill]] appears, knighting Lok and empowering him. As Incubane, Kagami and Dendras attack, Lok summons the Legendary Titan of Champions, [[Pendragon]], who breaks Wilder's control over Dendras, and defeats his [[Titans]]. Wilder is knocked out after being struck by the handle of the Willblade and Pendragon returns to the sword. As the castle collapses, Lok and Dante rescue Sophie. The team watches in shock as a [[Red Comet]] appears in the sky. Something has been set in motion and it's going to change the life of every [[Seeker]] on Earth.

Back at [[Dante Vale's house]], Lok and Cherit are unable to recall what happened on Avalon. As everyone leaves, Cherit ponders in mystery, sure that he saw his old friend, [[Lord Casterwill]], whose spectral form glows in the room.
